description: This file defines the 'EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport' class, which generates and manages employee leave entitlement and usage reports within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for report header and filter definitions, data retrieval, validation, and access control, utilizing various traits and external dependencies related to HR management and reporting.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport
classes.description: A report class responsible for generating leave entitlement and usage data for employees in the OrangeHRM system, with methods to define report headers, filters, validate inputs, and enforce access controls.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the header columns for the leave entitlement usage report, including titles and presentation properties.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns a filter object for the report; in this context, an empty filter.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on provided filter parameters, returning an EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData object.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates filter parameters for data retrieval, including employee number, date range, and report type.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rules for incoming request parameters to ensure data integrity and security.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the report, based on report type and system configurations.
